pieces.Text: The cabalist gains the shadowdancer's shadow jump ability with an effective shadowdancer level equal to his vigilante level - 6. If he has levels in shadowdancer, those levels stack with his vigilante levels to determine the total distance per day he can shadow jump (to a maximum of 320 feet per day). (The cabalist gains the ability to travel between shadows as if by means of a dimension door spell. The limitation is that the magical transport must begin and end in an area with at least some dim light. The cabalist can jump up to a total of
feet each day in this way; this may be a single jump or multiple jumps. This amount can be split among many jumps, but each one, no matter how small, counts as a 10-foot increment.)
